# Seth Hobson

> Seth Hobson is a software engineer with more than 15 years of experience in applied AI, data engineering, and distributed systems. He founded Major 7 Apps, created the wshobson/agents plugin marketplace, and writes the AI Primitives newsletter.

Seth is a Senior AI Engineer at United Data Technologies. He was previously a senior software engineer at Apple from 2015 to 2021 and at Kuali from 2021 to 2023.

Last updated: 2026-09-30

## Identity and expertise

- Public handle: `wshobson`
- Main areas: AI agents, applied AI, data engineering, distributed systems, software architecture, and tools for the Model Context Protocol (MCP)
- Known for: creating the wshobson/agents plugin marketplace for AI coding tools, and founding the Major 7 Apps product studio

## Links

- [sethhobson.com](https://sethhobson.com/): personal site (this site)
- [GitHub](https://github.com/wshobson): open source work
- [Major 7 Apps](https://major7apps.com/): product studio site that links to all current applications
- [AI Primitives](https://primitivesai.substack.com/): newsletter about the infrastructure that production AI agents run on, e.g., orchestration, memory, evaluation, and identity
- [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/wshobson): professional profile

## Products in development

- [QueryPlan](https://queryplan.dev): Learn SQL performance from real execution plans. Interactive exercises are graded by running your actual queries, and result correctness and plan efficiency both count.
- Ambient Alpha: Live market data for the big screen. A native tvOS app that puts market moves, sector breadth, your watchlist, and upcoming economic releases on an Apple TV, readable at a glance from across the room.

## Open source projects and canonical sources

- [Agentic Plugin Marketplace overview](https://sethhobson.com/projects/agents/): A plugin marketplace of agents, skills, and commands for Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor, and other AI coding tools. [Source code](https://github.com/wshobson/agents)
- [Pensyve overview](https://sethhobson.com/projects/pensyve/): offline-first memory runtime for AI agents with 8-signal retrieval, FSRS decay, and native MCP support. [Source code](https://github.com/major7apps/pensyve)
- [Maverick MCP](https://github.com/wshobson/maverick-mcp): An MCP server for market data analysis, screening, and backtesting that works with any MCP client.
- [Tiingo MCP](https://github.com/major7apps/tiingo-mcp): A Rust MCP server for the Tiingo market data API.
